Fix three PosturePilot issues without disturbing current working code.

  - “4-Pose Sequence Analysis”

- If per-segment overlay is null, show a clear placeholder state instead of empty UI.
- Best effort: add per-segment overlay generation by reusing existing overlay generator for each segment’s representative frame.
- Store segment overlay paths in segment report objects if implemented.
- If full per-segment overlay is not feasible in this pass, still make the UI gracefully show session overlay + explanatory message.

4. API / model consistency
- Ensure sequence report payload clearly indicates:
  - session overlay availability
  - segment overlay availability
  - overlay locked/unlocked state
- Avoid null-driven blank UI.

5. Tests
Add/update tests for:
- sequence summary/title
- no squat fallback in multi-pose mode
- report navigation buttons render
- sequence visual analysis fallback rendering

At the end print:
- root cause of squat text in sequence mode
- files changed
- whether sequence mode now shows session overlay fallback
- whether per-segment overlay was added or still pending
- what navigation actions were added
